name: Mobile hotspot kits
description: Borrow a mobile internet hotspot for three weeks, free with a library card.
eligibility: Anyone with a Dayton Metro Library card in good standing. One kit at a time.

steps: Get a library card if you do not have one.
Request a hotspot kit in the catalog or at any branch.
how_to_use.what_to_expect: Loans are 21 days, renewable up to five times if no one is waiting. A lost or damaged kit has a replacement fee.
